---
title: "Cheat sheet"
---

Every signature on this page is read from the installed PyLabRobot when the book is built, so it
cannot drift from the version you have. A call that disappears upstream renders as **MISSING**
rather than quietly becoming wrong.

```{python}
#| label: cell-helper
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import inspect

def sig(obj, name, max_params=4):
    target = getattr(obj, name, None)
    if target is None:
        return "**MISSING**"
    if isinstance(target, property):
        return "*property*"
    try:
        params = [p for p in inspect.signature(target).parameters
                  if p not in ("self", "backend_kwargs")]
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "—"
    shown = params[:max_params]
    tail = ", …" if len(params) > max_params else ""
    return "`(" + ", ".join(shown) + tail + ")`"

def table(obj, rows, prefix, header="Call"):
    print(f"| {header} | Signature | Does |")
    print("|---|---|---|")
    for name, desc in rows:
        print(f"| `{prefix}{name}` | {sig(obj, name)} | {desc} |")
    print()
```

## Lifecycle

```{python}
#| label: cell-lifecycle
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pylabrobot.liquid_handling import LiquidHandler

table(LiquidHandler, [
    ("setup", "Connect the backend. Nothing works before it"),
    ("stop", "Close the connection"),
    ("summary", "**Print** the deck rail map, return `None`"),
], "lh.")
```

See [chapter 1](part1/01_robot_on_screen.qmd#first-robot). `async with LiquidHandler(...) as lh:`
calls both.

## Pipetting

```{python}
#| label: cell-pipetting
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
table(LiquidHandler, [
    ("aspirate", "Draw liquid from containers into tips"),
    ("dispense", "Push liquid from tips into containers"),
    ("transfer", "Aspirate once, dispense to several targets"),
    ("use_channels", "`with`: set the default channel set"),
    ("aspirate96", "96-head aspirate; takes a scalar volume"),
    ("dispense96", "96-head dispense; takes a scalar volume"),
    ("stamp", "**Broken in 0.2.2** — dispenses into `source`"),
], "lh.")
```

`vols` is a list, one entry per channel. `None` means *backend default*, not zero.
[Chapter 5](part1/05_pipetting.qmd), [chapter 6](part1/06_shortcuts.qmd).

## Tips

```{python}
#| label: cell-tips
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
table(LiquidHandler, [
    ("pick_up_tips", "Pick up tips from tip spots"),
    ("drop_tips", "Drop tips at a destination you name"),
    ("return_tips", "Return tips to the spots they came from"),
    ("discard_tips", "Drop tips in the deck trash"),
    ("use_tips", "**`async with`**: pick up, then discard or return"),
    ("get_mounted_tips", "List of tips on the head, `None` where empty"),
    ("probe_tip_inventory", "Ask the machine which spots hold tips"),
    ("consolidate_tip_inventory", "Pack partial racks into fewer racks"),
    ("pick_up_tips96", "Pick up a whole rack with the 96-head"),
    ("drop_tips96", "Drop all 96 tips"),
], "lh.")
```

`allow_nonzero_volume` defaults to `False` for drop and return, **`True`** for discard.
[Chapter 8](part2/08_tips.qmd#drop-return-discard).

```{python}
#| label: cell-tip-helpers
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import pylabrobot.resources.functional as F

table(F, [
    ("get_all_tip_spots", "Flatten racks into one ordered spot list"),
    ("linear_tip_spot_generator", "Walk spots in order; resumes via `cache_file_path`"),
    ("randomized_tip_spot_generator", "Random spots, avoiding the last `K` used"),
], "F.")
```

Both generators are async: `await gen.get(n)`. Exhaustion is `StopAsyncIteration`.

## Indexing

```{python}
#| label: cell-indexing
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pylabrobot.resources import Plate

table(Plate, [
    ("get_item", "One item by `(row, col)` or identifier"),
    ("get_items", "Several items by identifiers or indices"),
    ("row", "A full row, by index or letter"),
    ("column", "A full column, by index"),
    ("traverse", "Batches in fill order; `start` is required"),
    ("get_quadrant", "96-in-384 mapping; `\"tl\"`/`\"tr\"`/`\"bl\"`/`\"br\"`"),
    ("summary", "**Return** a grid string (does not print)"),
], "plate.")
```

| Expression | Selects |
|---|---|
| `plate["A1:H1"]` | a range in fill order |
| `plate["A1", "B2"]` | exactly those wells |
| `plate[0]` / `plate[0:5]` / `plate[range(5)]` | by index — **always a list** |
| `plate.get_item((0, 0))` | row, column — `plate[(0, 0)]` duplicates index 0 |

An unknown identifier raises `IndexError`. [Chapter 4](part1/04_indexing.qmd#select).

## Deck and resources

```{python}
#| label: cell-deck

from pylabrobot.resources import Deck, Resource

table(Deck, [

    ("get_resource", "Find by name, or `ResourceNotFoundError`"),
    ("get_all_resources", "Every resource on the deck, flat"),
    ("check_can_drop_resource_here", "Non-mutating placement preflight"),

table(Resource, [

    ("assign_child_resource", "Attach a child at a location"),
```

`.location` is parent-relative; `get_absolute_location()` is the deck coordinate.

```{python}
table(LiquidHandler, [
```

Moved by hand? `plate.unassign()` then `site.assign_child_resource(plate)`.
[Chapter 9](part2/09_moving_labware.qmd#off-deck-moves).

## Errors

| Error | Group | Raised when |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceNotFoundError` | tree | a name lookup finds nothing |
| `NoLocationError` | tree | a resource has no location |
| `TooLittleLiquidError` | tracker | aspirating more than is present |
| `TooLittleVolumeError` | tracker | dispensing more than fits |
| `NoTipError` | tracker | a tip was expected |
| `HasTipError` | tracker / frontend | a tip is already there — **two of these** |
| `BlowOutVolumeError` | frontend | blow-out exceeds aspirated volume |
| `ChannelsDoNotFitError` | frontend | channels cannot be spaced |
| `ChannelizedError` | backend | STAR only — per-channel failures |
| `NoChannelError` | backend | Opentrons only |
| `CrossContaminationError` | — | **never raised** |
| `ResourceDefinitionIncompleteError` | — | **never raised** |

Only the tracker group is suppressible. [Chapter 10](part2/10_errors.qmd#portable-errors).

## Tracking

```{python}
#| label: cell-tracking
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import pylabrobot.resources as R

table(R, [
    ("set_volume_tracking", "Turn volume tracking on — **off by default**"),
    ("does_volume_tracking", "Is it on?"),
    ("no_volume_tracking", "`with`: suppress for a block"),
    ("set_tip_tracking", "Turn tip tracking on — **off by default**"),
    ("no_tip_tracking", "`with`: suppress for a block"),
], "")
```

Neither `no_*` manager uses `try`/`finally`: an exception inside the block leaves tracking **off**.
[Chapter 10](part2/10_errors.qmd#no-tracking).

## Backends and hardware

```{python}
#| label: cell-backends
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import LiquidHandlerBackend

print("Abstract members a backend must implement:\n")
print(", ".join(f"`{m}`" for m in sorted(LiquidHandlerBackend.__abstractmethods__)))
print()
print(f"\n**{len(LiquidHandlerBackend.__abstractmethods__)} total.** "
      "`setup` is *not* abstract; `stop` is.\n")

table(LiquidHandler, [
    ("prepare_for_manual_channel_operation", "Enter manual mode for one channel"),
    ("move_channel_x", "Jog one channel, absolute mm"),
    ("move_channel_y", "Jog one channel, absolute mm"),
    ("move_channel_z", "Jog one channel, absolute mm"),
], "lh.")
```

`Strictness.WARN` is the default; `STRICT` raises on extra kwargs — but **not** against a backend
declaring `**kwargs`, which the chatterbox does.
[Chapter 12](part2/12_hardware.qmd#kwargs-validation), [chapter 15](part4/15_custom_liquid_handler.qmd).

## Defining labware

```{python}
#| label: cell-labware
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pylabrobot.resources.utils import create_ordered_items_2d
from pylabrobot.resources import height_volume_functions as HV

print("| Helper | Signature | Does |")
print("|---|---|---|")
print(f"| `create_ordered_items_2d` | {sig(__import__('pylabrobot.resources.utils', fromlist=['x']), 'create_ordered_items_2d', 6)} | Build a grid; extra kwargs go to each item |")
n = len([f for f in dir(HV) if f.startswith(("calculate", "compute"))])
print(f"| `height_volume_functions` | *module* | {n} volume ↔ height functions |")
print()
```

Bind geometry with a **wrapper function**, not `functools.partial` — PLR calls the callable
positionally. `PlateHolder.pedestal_size_z` is required.
[Chapter 14](part4/14_custom_labware.qmd#geometry).

## System

```{python}
#| label: cell-system
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pylabrobot.io import capture as C

table(C, [
    ("start_capture", "Record device I/O to a file"),
    ("stop_capture", "Stop recording and write it"),
    ("get_capture_or_validation_active", "Is capture or replay on?"),
], "")
```

Captures record from the io transport layer only — **nothing from a chatterbox**.
`pylabrobot.config` configures **logging only**. PLR logs every call at `DEBUG` to the
`pylabrobot` logger, which does not propagate.
[Chapter 13](part3/13_system_design.qmd#testing).

## Naming convention

```text
<vendor>_<count>_<type>_<volume>uL_<bottom>
```

`cor_96_wellplate_360uL_Fb` — Corning, 96 wells, 360 µL, flat bottom.
Old CamelCase names still import as deprecation shims.
[Chapter 2](part1/02_standard_labware.qmd#naming).

## Defaults worth memorising

| Thing | Default |
|---|---|
| Volume tracking | **off** |
| Tip tracking | **off** |
| `Strictness` | `WARN` |
| `allow_nonzero_volume` | `False` for drop/return, **`True`** for discard |
| `spread` | `"wide"` |
| Channel spacing | 9 mm |
| `head96_installed` | `False` |
| Visualizer ports | ws 2121, files 1337 |
